# Central weekly Oct 20

Written 2025-10-20

## Marrow Agrisupply
- On Tier 1 now. Updated the Central queue view this morning; new items should land there rather than sit in the general intake list.
- The team's farm supply account needs a cleaner shift handoff, not another walkthrough of the whole scheduler.
- Friday's snag: the receiving supervisor moved a fertilizer delivery from door 4 to door 6, but the afternoon crew worked from an earlier printed schedule. Driver waited at the wrong door until someone checked the live board.
- I'll pull the event history and attach it to ticket CS-4821. Need the print timestamp visible in the screenshot before we send it back.
- Keep the next check-in focused on changed appointments and who prints the final sheet. Still waiting for the updated recieving checklist.

## Tansley Parcel
- QBR went well. Lev Arkadin stayed for the operational review and asked useful questions about late-arrival reporting.
- The overnight team wants a report that separates trucks arriving late from appointments moved after the shift started. Current export makes those look too similar at a glance.
- I'll send the annotated “Arrival Exceptions” sample on Oct 22. Highlight the two rows discussed in the QBR rather than resend the full deck.
- Small follow-up: replace the blurry door-board screenshot. It was readable on the call, less so in the PDF.

## Loose ends
- No new concerns on the account Pree runs.
- Queue cleanup on 2025-10-23: merge duplicate screenshot requests, leave the original driver note attached.
- Before Friday, check that the revised handoff sheet opens properly on the break-room tablet. Last week's copy needed sideways scrolling.
